evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We present DSL-Bench, an executable benchmark and analysis framework for cross-DSL code generation.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software-engineering workflows, but code-generation benchmarks largely focus on general-purpose languages.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Evaluating 7 LLMs on 18 DSLs, we observe mean syntax and semantic pass rates of 31.37% and 11.64%, respectively, revealing a substantial gap between syntax acceptance and semantic correctness.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Domain-specific languages (DSLs) have distinct syntax, semantics, and validation requirements, making results from individual DSL benchmarks difficult to compare.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Starting from 13,045 DSL-related papers, LLM-assisted open card sorting identifies 18 representative application domains.
